description: This file defines a PHP class 'DatabaseConfigAPI' that extends an abstract REST controller to handle API requests for database configuration in an installer process for the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to handle POST requests for configuring or testing database connections and GET requests to retrieve current database settings.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: A PHP class that handles API requests related to database configuration during system setup, including saving configuration data and retrieving current configuration.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to configure or test database connections, handling different scenarios such as new or existing database setup, validating parameters, and returning success or error responses.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current database configuration information stored in the StateContainer.
